about.full:
Hi, I'm **Firas**, known online as **FRL**. I specialize in cybersecurity, compete in CTFs, and work across production and design.

My security practice includes *Kali Linux*, *Python*, cryptography, *Blue Team* operations, *SOC* workflows, and *OSINT*. I enjoy understanding how systems fail, how defenders respond, and how clear thinking turns difficult challenges into practical results.

Alongside cybersecurity, I work as a producer and designer, using *After Effects*, *Blender*, *Photoshop*, and *AI* to build visual ideas and digital experiences.

This portfolio is a living space for my future projects, competition milestones, and creative work.

projects.title: ARBITER
projects.description:
ARBITER is an advanced OSINT and forensic analysis tool for SOC analysts and cybersecurity researchers. It uses Llama 3 through the Groq API to detect phishing intent, urgency, and coercion in email content; extracts IOCs; performs dual-engine IP geolocation; visualizes attacker origin on an interactive Leaflet map; generates PDF forensic dossiers; and calculates a dynamic 0–100% risk score.

Built with Python, Flask, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Leaflet.js, IP-API, and IPWhoIs.

projects.title: PassBit
projects.description:
PassBit is a privacy-first Manifest V3 Chrome extension that checks password strength locally, detects whether passwords have appeared in previous breaches through a privacy-preserving Pwned Passwords range query, suggests stronger alternatives, and stores favorites locally in an encrypted vault. It is dependency-free, uses no telemetry, and does not store passwords unless the user explicitly saves one.

Built with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Chrome Manifest V3, Web Crypto, and the Pwned Passwords API.
